summary: Navitas Semiconductor Corp filed an 8-K reporting entry into a definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire Claros, Inc. Navitas will acquire Claros through two-step mergers: first merging Merger Sub 1 into Claros, then merging Claros into Merger Sub 2 LLC. Total estimated consideration is ~$232.8 million, comprising ~$126.4 million cash, ~6.9 million shares of Navitas common stock valued at ~$89.7 million (based on $12.97 reference price), and up to ~1.28 million earnout shares (worth ~$16.7 million). The deal includes an S-4 registration for the stock consideration. Watch for shareholder approvals and merger completion conditions.
